chapter_title: The Chapter of the Three Seasons
spiritual_reading:
#
 The
 Three
 States
 of Spiritual Redem
ption

## A Translation
 into
 the
 Spiritual
 Sense

---


**
¶1.
** From the state
 when divine
 wisdom first
 went
 forth and became
 bound within
 falsity, to the state when the
 perf
ected Divine Image shall arise
 and all wisdom
 that had
 been conjoined with falsity shall
 be separated and made
 pure — from that first state to the
 final cons
ummation comprises three great states of spiritual
 development.

**¶2.
** Three
 states: from when the celestial will
 first
 descended into the deepest regions
 of evil,
 and w
aged spiritual combat against the ruling love of
 self and all its derivative powers. The
 celestial will prevailed, yet
 its offspring
 —
 the derivative goods proce
eding from it
 — remained behind among the states of evil
,
 until every
 last
 one should
 be reclaimed. It
 bound
 fast
 every
 opposing
 power,
 so that not
 one escaped. A vast
 spiritual victory was won
. The celestial will endured through
 innumerable successive states of
 tem
ptation in the realm of falsity
, until it prevailed and fulfilled the
 purpose of the Divine that had been commanded
 of
 it.

**¶3.
** Then there was sent forth the Divine
 operating
 through spiritual good, together with the origin
 of all
 life. These raised the celestial will
 up
 out
 of spiritual combat and restored it to the
 state of heavenly wisdom. This is
 the first state: from the descent of
 the celestial will into falsity to
 its elevation
.

**¶4.**
 The second state begins
 from the restoration of the celestial will
. The Divine operating through spiritual good came
,
 together with the Divine Truth that gives life
. They set
 in
 order all the
 things of the spiritual world;
 the
 Divine Good and the Divine Truth arranged
 the whole
 of the spiritual world —
 its
 planes
, its degrees
, its forms
 —
 until
 the ordering
 was complete. This was reckoned
 to
 the second state.

**¶
5.** Then
 the Divine Rational extended
 itself
 through
 all
 the powers of life
.
 It separated what was
 genuinely good and beautiful from every
 power
 of evil,
 and raised it up to celestial states
;
 it swept
 what was waste and corrupt down
 into the deepest falsity. Now
,
 from the moment the
 Divine Rational revealed its form, it
 purified the
 wisdom that
 was
 held
 capt
ive.
 But evil erupted toward it. The
 Divine Rational concealed its form.
 Evil came
 forth
 out
 of falsity. It corrupted the
 perceptions, and monstrous fals
ities —
 ab
ortive
 thoughts without
 life
 — fell
 down
ward. Afterward, evil
 fash
ioned the external
 natural
 human
,
 both
 its
 understanding
 and its will,
 in the merely
 corporeal state. Until the moment when
 the Divine Truth
 Itself was sent,
 and
 It
 accomplished there Its
 purpose.
 It gave the hope of regeneration to
 the natural human, and ascended to
 celestial states.

**¶
6.** Now
, from the state when the Divine
 Rational displayed its form until the state when
 the perf
ected Divine Image shall arise at the cons
ummation — this shall
 be reckoned to the third state
.

**¶8.**
 The first state endures far beyond
 r
eckoning in
 the inn
umerable successive states the
 celestial will spent in the realm of
 falsity.
 It
 is a vastly greater spiritual
 duration than the other two states.


**¶9.** How
 much greater is the first state —
 in
 which
 the celestial will dw
elt within
 the realm of falsity — than the
 entire duration of the ordered
 spiritual world as it has stood
?

**¶10.**
 If you attempt
 to measure it,
 every
 measure
 proves
 insufficient
. One might say twenty times the duration
 of the ordered world — yet in another
 reckoning, thirty times. And
 still less does
 this suff
ice.
 Humanity
 will receive the works of their perceptions
 — the successive states and generations ascending
 from the natural plane to celestial states
.
 This is beyond
 final
 calculation
.

**¶11.**
 This
 is the third state:
 from when the Divine Rational revealed its
 form until the perfected Divine Image asc
ends out of the gross
 mass of disordered nature. This
 third state is greater in duration than the
 intermediate state; yet it does not come
 equal to the first
 state of the celestial will. For
 the intermediate state —
 in which the Divine Good and the Divine
 Truth constructed the spiritual world with all its
 orders and
 degrees — is shorter than the
 so
journ of the celestial will in
 falsity.

**¶12
.** Great beyond measure is the first
 state of the celestial will! It
 endures longer than the state from when
 the Divine Rational displayed its form to
 the dissolution of the natural world and the
 rising
 of the perfected Divine Image. And
 the time from when the Divine Rational
 displayed its form to the dissolution of the
 spiritual world likewise
 exceeds the time when the Divine Good
 and the Divine Truth shaped the spiritual world
 into order.

**¶13
.** These are the three great states
 of spiritual development through which all redem
ption passes.

---


###
 A
 Note on the Three
 States


Read
 as
 correspondence,
 the
 architecture
 is
 unm
istakable: the
 first
 state is the longest
 because
 the
 struggle
 of
 the celestial will within
 the
 deep
est falsity —
 the prim
ordial tem
ptation-
combat
 that makes
 all
 subsequent
 regener
ation possible — is the most interior
 and therefore
 the most imm
ense
 in
 spiritual
 duration. The second state,
 in which the Divine
 Good and Divine
 Truth order
 the spiritual world into
 form
, is the brief
est:
 the establishment
 of order
,
 once
 the combat
 is won
, is the sw
iftest work
.
 The third state —
 the long
 labor
 of separ
ating wisdom
 from falsity through
 the rational
 faculty
,
 culmin
ating in the sending
 of the Divine Truth
 Itself into
 the human
 natural
 and
 the
 final
 raising
 of the perfected Image
 — stands
 between
 the two.
 This
 progression
 mirrors
 exactly
 what
 Swedenborg describes as
 the three degrees
 of regener
ation:
 the celest
ial combat
 of
 the will
, the ordering
 of tru
ths into
 spiritual
 form
, and the long
 natural
-
plane
 labor
 of pur
ification that
 ends
 only
 when the Divine Human
 is fully
 received
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: From the time when the light came forth and was crucified in the darkness, to the season when the Statue will ascend and the entire light, which was conjoined with the darkness, will be purified and cleansed. From that time on, from that time to the season of the end totals three seasons.

Three seasons: from the time when the First Man went down to the abyss, and waged the war and the struggle against the King of the realms of Darkness and his other powers. He was victorious, while his sons remain behind with them in the worlds [of darkness, held captive] in the [deep,] until he shall catch all of them [and reclaim them. And] he bound them all up, so that not one of them escaped his hand. He won a great victory [over all the dark powers.] The First Man spent human lifetimes and generations in the land of darkness, until he prevailed [and] he fulfilled the will of the greatness that was commanded of him.

Then they sent the Living Spirit, the Father of Life. He brought the First Man up from the struggle, he brought him up to the land of light. This is the first period, from the descent of the First Man to his ascent.

The second season is from the time when the First Man ascended. The Living Spirit came, and the Mother of Life. They set in order the things of the universe, they set up [the heavens and the earths.] the Father of Life and the Mother of the living set in order [all the planes and degrees of] the universe, up to the moment when they go out [and the ordering is complete;] it was reckoned to the second season.

[After the ordering of] the universe [was completed,] the Third Ambassador spread [his image over all] that is in the [world of the] living; he [revealed his form, and] he separated beauty from all the powers and scooped it up to the heights, he swept the waste to the abyss, and he [purified the mixture.] Now, from the moment when the Ambassador revealed his image he purified the light. Sin spurted up towards him. He hid his image. Sin came [forth] from the darkness. It sculpted the trees and the abortions fell down. Afterwards they sculpted Adam and Eve in the flesh. Until the moment when Jesus was sent and he [came to the world of the flesh,] as he performed there his will. He gave the hope to Adam, and ascended to the heights.
Now, from the time when the Ambassador displayed his image until the season when the Statue will ascend at the end, shall be reckoned to the third season.
[The first season] lasts long in the time that the First Man spent in the world of darkness. It is a very great count of time, more than the (other) two seasons!
The first season, which the First Man spent in the world of darkness, is how much longer than the time that this universe has been? While it is established?

This is the third period, from the time when the Ambassador revealed his image until the Statue will ascend from the lump. It again, that time, is greater than the intermediate; but it does not come equal to the time of the First Man. For this intermediate season, in which the Father of Life and the Mother of Life constructed the universe with its orders, is shorter than that of the First Man.

Great is the period of the First Man! It lasts longer than the season in which the Ambassador displayed his image, until the dissolution of the world and the Statue ascends. From the time too when the Ambassador displayed his image, until the dissolution of the universe [is greater than the time] when the Father of Life and the Mother of Life shaped the universe.
These are the [great] three periods of time that occur.
